etymologies.etymologyHTML: From Ancient Greek αὐτός (autós, “self”), metanalyzed from auto- in words such as automatic, autopilot, and automobile.

definitions.definition: (automotive) A car with an automatic gearbox/transmission.

quote.text: The food was excellent and well served, and it recalled the Norman cities he had autoed to.

quote.citation: 1924, The Smith Alumnae Quarterly, volumes 16-17, page 318:
quote.text: Christmas Day we decided to spend in snow, in order to feel more at home, and so we autoed up 5000 ft. to Peira Cava and reveled in the winter sports, autoing back to the roses and “summer time” at nightfall.

etymologies.etymologyHTML: Clipping of autorickshaw, from Hindi ऑटो रिक्शा (ŏṭo rikśā).
